title: Mixtures of In-Context Learners
abstract: arXiv:2411.02830v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) adapts LLMs by providing demonstrations without fine-tuning the model parameters; however, it does not differentiate between demonstrations and quadratically increases the complexity of Transformer LLMs, exhausting the memory. As a solution, we propose Mixtures of In-Context Learners (MoICL), a novel approach to treat subsets of demonstrations as experts and learn a weighting function to merge their output distributions based on a training set. In our experiments, we show performance improvements on 5 out of 7 classification datasets compared to a set of strong baselines (up to +13\% compared to ICL and LENS). Moreover, we enhance the Pareto frontier of ICL by reducing the inference time needed to achieve the same performance with fewer demonstrations. translated_title: 上下文学习器混合模型
translated_abstract: 上下文学习通过提供示例（演示）来适应大语言模型，而无需微调模型参数；然而，它无法区分不同的示例，并且会使Transformer大语言模型的复杂度呈平方级增长，从而耗尽内存。作为解决方案，我们提出了上下文学习器混合模型（MoICL），这是一种新颖的方法，它将演示示例的子集视为“专家”，并基于训练集学习一个加权函数来合并它们的输出分布。在实验中，与一组强基线相比，我们在7个分类数据集中的5个上展示了性能提升（与ICL和LENS相比最高提升+13%）。此外，我们通过减少以更少示例达到相同性能所需的推理时间，改善了ICL的帕累托前沿。最后，MoICL对域外示例（最高+11%）、不平衡示例（最高+49%）或噪声示例（最高+38%）更加鲁棒，或者可以过滤掉这些示例。
tldr: 提出MoICL方法，将上下文学习的演示示例子集视为专家并学习加权函数来合并其输出分布，在提升分类性能的同时减少推理时间，并显著增强了对域外、不平衡和噪声示例的鲁棒性。
